description: Last login timestamp stored as a string, although the intended type is datetime64[ns]. The column is complete with 0 missing values out of 30 records and contains 28 distinct non-null values, making it near-unique with 2 repeated timestamps. Observed values range from '2019-01-01 00:00:00' to '2024-05-12 00:00:00', and all values are consistently 19 characters long in a datetime-like format.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the column from string to datetime64[ns] using the consistently observed 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format; 100% of observed values follow examples such as '2023-03-30 00:00:00'.

[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: 4-digit year, hyphen, 2-digit month, hyphen, 2-digit day, space, 2-digit hour, colon, 2-digit minute, colon, 2-digit second — e.g., '2024-05-12 00:00:00'.
